verdict.rationale: Unity's own marketing says it builds both 2D and 3D games, which places 2D development within the product's stated scope. That is a single headline claim; nothing in the pack documents sprite tooling, tilemaps or 2D physics, or shows 2D is first-class rather than secondary. Missing for 10: documentation of sprite workflows, tilemap tooling, 2D physics, evidence 2D is first-class rather than bolted onto 3D, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a game developer, 2D is a first-class workflow — sprites, tilemaps, 2D physics — not a 3D afterthought

citations.quote: Build 2D and 3D games for any platform
